page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew word forms with Latin glosses, the left column ending before the catchword, the right column ending with the catchword at the lower right. Running head in Hebrew letters at the top of each column. Page number 447 at the top right.

main_text.l: m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָתַר.
sing. fæm. Rad. עוּד testatus est...
תְּעַנֵּנוּ præstigiabimini, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. עַיִן oculus.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible; the vowel points on several forms are uncertain and could be misread, especially in the left column lines 3–4 and the forms תַּעְגְּבָה and תַּעְגּוֹב. "adamabit" in Latin letters is a printed gloss with uncertain spelling. The running head is Hebrew letters ת ע repeated on both pages. The catchword תעף is at the lower right of the right column. The page number 447 is at the top right.
